subject: GitHub Actions self-hosted runner dispatch admission for the WP1207 clay-direct-dev target gate

external_primary.relevance: GitHub routes a self-hosted job only to an online and idle runner matching the job's runs-on labels/groups; an assigned runner that does not pick up within 60 seconds causes requeue; without an eligible online/idle runner the job remains queued and ultimately fails after 24 hours.

external_primary.source: GitHub Docs — REST API endpoints for self-hosted runners
external_primary.relevance: The repository runner-roster API exposes runner id, name, OS, status, busy state, ephemeral state, version and labels when the caller has the required administration read permission.

external_primary.source: GitHub Docs — Using labels with self-hosted runners
external_primary.relevance: Custom labels are supported for routing jobs to runner types/capabilities; runner groups are another routing surface.

source_observations.observation: The exact WP1207 target-gate workflow at controller source 612edec9e5361e6bcdbbc6fc6b0f005f68eb2a2b declares runs-on: self-hosted with no additional capability label or runner group.

The workflow then searches its assigned runner for docker, podman, incus or lxc access to a target named clay-direct-dev; if that capability is absent it writes BLOCKED_SANDBOX_NOT_DISCOVERED and exits without target runtime credit.
At this research read, canonical WP1207 run 33308615022/job 99249501627 remained queued with no executed steps. This is control-plane/transport evidence only.

The installed GitHub connector rejects GET /repos/gschaidergabriel/Dr.-Unterweger/actions/runners as an unsupported endpoint family. Therefore this organ cannot observe the registered runner roster/status/labels and must keep OFFLINE/BUSY/LABEL_MISMATCH/GROUP_MISMATCH unresolved.

hypothesis.statement: The current broad runs-on:self-hosted contract admits a placement-ambiguity class: if multiple self-hosted runners are ever eligible, GitHub may assign a runner that lacks the clay-direct-dev bridge. A target-capability routing label or runner-group constraint can reduce that ambiguity before workflow execution.

counterhypothesis.statement: The repository may have exactly one eligible self-hosted runner, or policy/group configuration may already constrain it externally; in that case adding another label provides little current routing benefit and could itself strand jobs if the label is not maintained.
counterhypothesis.cheapest_discriminator: Through an already-authorized runner-admin surface, read the current repository/organization runner roster plus labels/groups and compare them with the WP1207 runs-on contract. If exactly one eligible runner exists and it is the intended clay-direct-dev bridge host, do not add a redundant label solely for aesthetics.

architecture_candidate.name: RUNNER_ELIGIBILITY_ADMISSION_FENCE
minimal_delta: Represent target-host transport eligibility separately from runtime success.

If roster evidence shows multiple or ambiguous self-hosted runners, constrain WP1207 routing with a dedicated capability label such as clay-direct-dev-bridge and/or the already-authoritative runner group; do not invent a new scheduler.
Treat any routing label/group as candidate eligibility metadata only. It must never attest that clay-direct-dev actually exists, that the exact artifact ran, or that runtime credit is earned.

Retain the workflow's first-step runtime/container discovery as the direct capability measurement and bind the observed runner identity plus exact controller/F2/artifact identities into the external receipt.

Where an already-authorized runner-roster read is available, require an eligible online/idle observation before dispatch or classify RUNNER_STATUS_UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE and avoid queue-amplifying redispatch. If the roster surface is unavailable, do not infer OFFLINE.
A queued zero-step job remains transport/control-plane evidence, never WP1207 semantic failure.
architecture_candidate.reject_condition: Reject a new label/group requirement if exact roster/group inspection proves a single unambiguous intended runner and the added metadata would only duplicate existing routing authority without reducing a real failure class.
architecture_candidate.trigger4_handoff: Consume the parallel runner-roster result first. At E2, map the existing WP1207 execution-surface resolution to explicit states RUNNER_STATUS_UNKNOWN -> ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE -> ASSIGNED -> STEP_EXECUTION_OBSERVED -> CLAY_DIRECT_DEV_CAPABILITY_OBSERVED -> EXACT_TARGET_RECEIPT. Only the last evidence-bearing stages can support bounded runtime promotion.

coordination.duplicate_policy: This E1 closes only the narrower dispatch-admission/source-mapping claim and delegates architecture fusion to the already-active E2 lanes. No competing E2 claim is created.

next_exact_action: Do not create another runner E2 lane. Let the already-claimed runner-evidence/diagnostic E2 workers map this candidate together with the runner-roster result, then Trigger 4 should use the resulting nonduplicate transport discriminator before any WP1207 redispatch or runtime-credit decision.
